title: Lut Gaya Zainab Ka Kunba Nana Jaan Pardes Me
body:
Lut Gaya Zainab Ka Kunba Nana Jaan Pardes Me
<<MINI>>
Guzri Hai Kaisi Ajab Majburiya Pardes Me
<<DIVIDER>>
Bete Ki Maiyat Padi Ho Aur Maa Na Ro Sake
<<MINI>>
Guzri Hai Kaisi Ajab Majburiya Pardes Me
<<DIVIDER>>
Darpe Zainab Ghash Me Abid Naher Pe Abbas The
Bhai Par Jis Dam Huwa Qanjar Rawa Pardes Me
Turbat-e-Asghar Pa Sar Rakh Kar Sakina Ne Kaha
Chod Kar Kis Par Gaye Hum Ko Yaha Pardes Me
<<DIVIDER>>
Wasta Baba Ka Tum Ko Sath Me Bhaiya Chalo
Kahyegi Teri Behen Na Ghurkiya Pardes Me
Lasha-e-Shabbir Larza Aur Sakina Ro Padi
Shimr Ne Khe-Che The Jis Dam Baliya Pardes Me
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaima-e- Shai Me Vizarat Hogaya Mehshar Bapa
Jis Ghadi Maa Ne Bhadayi Hasilya Pardes Me
